title: 🚨 Coin50 Index, Pre-IPO OpenAI, & EURC Perpetuals. Coming to Deribit
body:
On Monday September 21, 2026 at 10:00 AM UTC, Deribit will launch the following USDC-settled perpetual markets:

• COIN50_USDC, offering exposure to the Coin50 Index through a perpetual contract
• OPENAI_USDC, a pre-IPO perpetual linked to OpenAI
• EURC_USDC, The euro-backed stablecoin issued by Circle

Contract details:
🔹 Settlement: USDC
🔹 Full specifications: Deribit RWA Perpetual contract details

title: 🔔 Update: Spot Routing Completed
body:
All announced spot routing markets are now live and routed through Coinbase Exchange liquidity on Deribit:

• BTC-USDC
• ETH-USDC
• XRP-USDC
• BNB-USDC
• SOL-USDC
• PAXG-USDC

Benefit from deeper liquidity and improved execution quality. Routed pairs will follow Deribit’s applicable Fee Schedule and CBE market specifications. For pair-level specifications, see the Spot Instruments page.

title: 🚨 More new perpetual futures are coming to Deribit
body:
We are pleased to announce that on September 18, 2026, at 10:00 AM UTC, Deribit is launching a new lineup of USDC-settled perpetuals.

MORPHO · AERO · BASED1 · S · EIGEN · JTO · NIGHT · AVNT · STRK · COMP · ALT · DYDX · OPN · TOWNS · PYTH · RUNE · RESOLV · ATOM

Contract details:
🔹Settlement: USDC
🔹Click here for all contract details and specifications.

See here for more information.

Please note that these newly listed perpetual contracts are subject to our Auto-Deleveraging Mechanism (ADL) and are covered by the Liquidity Support Program (LSP). By trading any of the products listed above, you acknowledge and agree that the terms of ADL and LSP will apply.

For more information on how ADL works, when it may be triggered, and which Instruments are in scope, please refer to the ADL article available in our Knowledge Base. For more information about the LSP, please refer to the LSP article available in our Knowledge Base.
